EC1: - Has previously received inotersen [OR] or patisiran
EC2: - Has clinically significant liver function test abnormalities
EC3: - Has known portal hypertension [AND] with ascites
EC4: - Has estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) ≤30 mL/min/1.73 m^2
EC6: - Has infection [AND] with hepatitis B, [OR] hepatitis C [OR] or human immunodeficiency virus (HIV)
EC7: - Has New York Heart Association heart failure classification of >2
EC9: - Has received organ transplants other than liver transplant
EC10: - Will be using an other tetramer stabilizer during the study
